parameters.formDescription: Installiert DLRG Trainer, ntfy und Bitwarden, entfernt alle anderen Apps der Liste, blendet alle uebrigen Apps aus und setzt den Hintergrund samt Sperrbildschirm-Text.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, mode: 'auto', serial: '' } }];

const input = $input.first().json;
const cfg = {
  nanomdmUrl: 'http://mdm-nanomdm.mdm.svc.cluster.local:9000',
  depserverUrl: 'http://mdm-depserver.mdm.svc.cluster.local:9001',
  scepUrl: 'http://mdm-scep.mdm.svc.cluster.local:8080',
  publicHost: 'mdm-prod.pke-lab.de',
  depName: 'capulus',
  ntfyUrl: 'http://ntfy.ntfy.svc.cluster.local',
  ntfyTopic: 'Home-Lab-MDM',
  vmUrl: 'http://vmsingle-monitoring-victoria-metrics-k8s-stack.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:8428',
  n8nUrl: 'https://n8n.prod.homeserver',
  mode: input.mode,
  serial: input.serial,
  standardBundleIds: ['app.dlrg.trainer', 'io.heckel.ntfy', 'com.8bit.bitwarden'],
  lockScreenText: 'DLRG OG Andernach | Admin bei Fragen Peter Kretzer'
};
return [{ json: cfg }];

parameters.query: SELECT e.id AS enrollment_id, d.serial_number FROM public.enrollments e JOIN public.devices d ON d.id = e.device_id WHERE e.type = 'Device' AND e.enabled AND ($1::text = '' OR d.serial_number = $1::text) AND ($2::text = 'manual' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM automation.setting s WHERE s.key = 'grundeinrichtung:' || e.id)) ORDER BY d.serial_number

INSERT INTO automation.setting (key, value)
SELECT 'grundeinrichtung:' || id, now()::text FROM unnest(string_to_array($1, ',')) AS id
ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
RETURNING key

UPDATE automation.app_catalog
SET enabled = (bundle_id = ANY (string_to_array($1, ',')))
RETURNING adam_id, name, bundle_id, config, enabled

UPDATE automation.profile_state p
SET params = jsonb_set(p.params, '{ALLOWED_APPS}', n.list), version = p.version + 1, updated_at = now()
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(b ORDER BY b), '[]'::jsonb) AS list
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(params->'SYSTEM_APPS') AS b FROM automation.profile_state WHERE name = 'app-allowlist'
    UNION
    SELECT bundle_id FROM automation.app_catalog WHERE enabled
  ) u
) n
WHERE p.name = 'app-allowlist' AND p.params->'ALLOWED_APPS' IS DISTINCT FROM n.list
RETURNING p.version

WITH claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO automation.device_profile AS d (enrollment_id, profile_name, version, state, claimed_at)
  SELECT e.id, p.name, p.version, 'claimed', now()
  FROM public.enrollments e CROSS JOIN automation.profile_state p
  WHERE e.id = ANY (string_to_array($1, ',')) AND e.type = 'Device' AND e.enabled AND p.enabled
  ON CONFLICT (enrollment_id, profile_name) DO UPDATE
    SET version = EXCLUDED.version, state = 'claimed', claimed_at = now(), command_uuid = NULL, sent_at = NULL
    WHERE d.version < EXCLUDED.version
       OR d.state IN ('failed', 'error')
       OR EXCLUDED.profile_name = 'wallpaper'
       OR (d.state = 'claimed' AND d.claimed_at < now() - interval '10 minutes')
  RETURNING d.enrollment_id, d.profile_name, d.version
)
SELECT c.enrollment_id, c.profile_name, c.version, p.kind, p.template, p.params
FROM claimed c JOIN automation.profile_state p ON p.name = c.profile_name
ORDER BY (p.kind <> 'wallpaper'), c.profile_name

UPDATE automation.profile_state
SET params = jsonb_set(params, '{TEXT}', to_jsonb($1::text)), version = version + 1, updated_at = now()
WHERE name = 'lockscreen' AND params->>'TEXT' IS DISTINCT FROM $1::text
RETURNING version

parameters.jsCode:
const crypto = require('crypto');
const claimed = $input.all().map((item) => item.json).filter((row) => row.profile_name);
if (claimed.length === 0) return [{ json: { skip: true } }];
const escapeXml = (value) => String(value)
  .replace(/&/g, '&')
  .replace(/</g, '<')
  .replace(/>/g, '>')
  .replace(/"/g, '"');
return claimed.map((row) => {
  const params = typeof row.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(row.params) : row.params;
  let profile = row.template;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    const text = Array.isArray(value)
      ? value.map((item) => '				<string>' + escapeXml(item) + '</string>').join('
')
      : escapeXml(value);
    profile = profile.split('__' + key + '__').join(text);
  }
  profile = profile.split('__VERSION__').join(String(row.version));
  const commandUuid = crypto.randomUUID();
  if (row.kind === 'wallpaper') {
    const settings = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
'
      + '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
'
      + '<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Command</key>
	<dict>
		<key>RequestType</key>
		<string>Settings</string>
'
      + '		<key>Settings</key>
		<array>
			<dict>
				<key>Image</key>
				<data>' + params.IMAGE_B64 + '</data>
'
      + '				<key>Item</key>
				<string>Wallpaper</string>
'
      + '				<key>Where</key>
				<integer>' + Number(params.WHERE || 3) + '</integer>
			</dict>
		</array>
'
      + '	</dict>
	<key>CommandUUID</key>
	<string>' + commandUuid + '</string>
</dict>
</plist>
';
    return { json: { skip: false, enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id, profile_name: row.profile_name, version: row.version, command_uuid: commandUuid, plist: settings } };
  }
  const plist = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
'
    + '<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
'
    + '<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Command</key>
	<dict>
		<key>Payload</key>
		<data>'
    + Buffer.from(profile, 'utf8').toString('base64')
    + '</data>
		<key>RequestType</key>
		<string>InstallProfile</string>
	</dict>
	<key>CommandUUID</key>
	<string>'
    + commandUuid + '</string>
</dict>
</plist>
';
  return { json: { skip: false, enrollment_id: row.enrollment_id, profile_name: row.profile_name, version: row.version, command_uuid: commandUuid, plist } };
});

parameters.query:
UPDATE automation.device_profile
SET state = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN 'queued' ELSE 'failed' END,
    command_uuid = CASE WHEN $4 = 'yes' THEN $3 ELSE NULL END,
    sent_at = now()
WHERE enrollment_id = $1 AND profile_name = $2
RETURNING enrollment_id, profile_name, state, $5::text AS detail

meta.description: Richtet iPads mit den Standard-Apps ein: DLRG Trainer, ntfy und Bitwarden. Ablauf: Katalog automation.app_catalog auf genau diese drei Apps setzen (alle anderen Katalog-Apps deaktivieren), Lizenz geraetegebunden zuweisen (POST /mdm/v2/assets/associate), InstallApplication fuer die Standard-Apps und RemoveApplication fuer alle uebrigen Katalog-Apps einreihen, die Erlaubt-Liste (Profil app-allowlist) neu berechnen, den Sperrbildschirm-Text (Profil lockscreen) auf DLRG OG Andernach | Admin bei Fragen Peter Kretzer setzen, dann Hintergrund (wallpaper wird immer neu gesendet), wallpaper-lock, lockscreen und app-allowlist per automation.device_profile an die Geraete schicken. Alle Apps ausserhalb der Erlaubt-Liste werden auf beaufsichtigten iPads ausgeblendet; deinstalliert werden koennen nur verwaltete Apps. Zwei Trigger: Formular (Seriennummer leer = alle iPads, jederzeit wiederholbar) und alle 10 Minuten (nur iPads ohne Eintrag grundeinrichtung:<Enrollment-ID> in automation.setting, also jedes neue iPad genau einmal; ohne Meldung, wenn es nichts zu tun gibt). Credentials: MDM Formulare, MDM NanoMDM API, MDM Automation DB, Apple Apps Token, ntfy-publisher.
